name: ux-ui-agent-skills-codex
description: Codex plugin build of HiroshiYoshino/ux-ui-agent-skills: design-system skills (tokens, components, accessibility) and the objective quality gates, ported from the Claude Code skills. A fork of plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills. Not the npm package of the same name.

interface.displayName: UX/UI Agent Skills (Codex build, HiroshiYoshino fork)
interface.shortDescription: Design-system skills and objective gates. Skills and MCP only: no hooks.
interface.longDescription: Design-system skills for Codex: DTCG tokens, component specs, WCAG 2.2 accessibility and the gates that measure the result. This is the Codex build of the HiroshiYoshino fork of plugin87/ux-ui-agent-skills (MIT, original author Thientan Soparat). It ships skills and one MCP server. It does not ship the Claude Code hooks: nothing here records or blocks on your behalf, so run the gates and report what they print. Gates that open a browser need playwright installed separately.
defaultPrompt: Use the design-doctrine skill, then design a settings screen.
